name: How long does fire restoration take?

mainEntity.name: How long does fire restoration take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of fire restoration varies significantly based on the extent of the damage. Minor fire and smoke damage might be resolved in a few days to a week. More extensive structural damage and widespread soot contamination can extend the process to several weeks or even months, especially if reconstruction is required. An initial assessment provides a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fire restoration time depends on damage severity, ranging from a few days for minor issues to several weeks or months for extensive damage.
